paper.title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data
paper.central_claim: Proposer–Coder–Solver 三角色从零外部训练数据交替GRPO训练，使VLM视觉推理能力提高。

provenance.notes: 按派发配置sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立后端/会话回执，不探测。

evidence.quote: All three roles are initialized from the same base model and trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
evidence.support_explanation: 改进对象为三角色模型权重。

evidence.quote: Each model is optimized sequentially via GRPO, with role-specific reward functions that form a closed training loop.
evidence.support_explanation: 交替训练，不是修改持久非权重harness。

evidence.quote: We retain only successfully rendered images and their associated questions as the training set for the solver.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留数据用于训练；未成为后续任务读取的技能/工具库。

evidence.quote: All three models use full fine-tuning (LoRA rank 0); the vision tower is trainable.
evidence.support_explanation: 全文附录明确被更新和留存对象是参数。

evidence.quote: Since ground truth labels are unavailable for these generated questions, we use Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) via majority voting.
evidence.support_explanation: 自监督多数票信号用于模型训练。

evidence.quote: We train the ablated model using identical hyperparameters for three iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: 消融也评价训练后的模型，不评价代码工具的留存。
